title: IAM Engineer-Ping Federate
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior IAM Engineer specializing in PingFederate and PingAccess to join our team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, implementing, and supporting robust, secure authentication and authorization solutions within a complex enterprise environment.

  

You will play a key part in driving our identity modernization efforts, building custom extensions, and securing seamless access across our core enterprise applications and modern cloud systems.

  

At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

* IAM Architecture & Implementation: Design, deploy, and maintain secure enterprise authentication, federation, and authorization solutions centered on PingFederate and PingAccess.
* Custom Development & Integrations: Utilize solid Java skills and the Ping SDK to develop, optimize, and maintain custom Ping adapters, plugins, and custom integrations tailored to enterprise needs.
* Protocol & Standards Management: Drive implementation and best practices for modern identity protocols including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), FIDO2, and Single Sign-On (SSO).
* CI/CD & DevOps Automation: Integrate IAM configurations and deployment workflows into continuous integration and delivery pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* System Support & Troubleshooting: Perform root-cause analysis, advanced troubleshooting, and issue resolution for complex identity, access, and federation flows across systems.
Proactive Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional security, infrastructure, and development teams to advocate for secure, solution-oriented identity practices.  

  

Your future at Kyndryl

  

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good

What you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Qualification

* Total Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM).
* Ping Identity Suite: Deep hands-on experience with PingFederate and PingAccess.
* IAM Protocols: Strong, foundational understanding of enterprise IAM concepts, standards, and protocols—including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, FIDO2, and SSO.
* Java Development & SDK: Solid Java development capabilities, specifically in building, extending, and maintaining custom Ping adapters, plugins, and integrations using the Ping SDK.
* DevOps & Delivery: Practical experience working with Azure DevOps and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
Domain Focus: Proven, demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), and federation solutions in complex environments.  

  

Preferred Qualification

  

* Groovy scripting experience.
Exposure to or experience with broader Ping products and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Tenable Architect/Administrator
description:

We are looking for a Tenable Security Architect / Administrator to lead the end\-to\-end design, deployment, administration, and automation of our enterprise vulnerability management infrastructure across hybrid environments.  



  

In this varied and dynamic role, you will shape asset classification models, risk assessment reports, security policies, and implementation plans while configuring and monitoring networks to defend our enterprise infrastructure against cyber threats.  



  

Look no further – Kyndryl is seeking a Cybersecurity Specialist to join our team of talented Technical Specialists.

You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.  



  

Key responsibility  



  

* Architecture \& Design: Design, scale, and maintain Tenable architecture (Security Center, Tenable.io / Tenable Vulnerability Management, and Nessus Scanners) across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Platform Administration: Oversee day\-to\-day operations, including scan policies, repositories, RBAC, platform upgrades, plugin updates, and troubleshooting scan or connectivity issues.
* Vulnerability Management \& Remediation: Analyze scan results, prioritize vulnerabilities based on CVSS and business risk, and partner with cross\-functional IT/cloud teams to drive and validate remediation efforts.
* Automation \& Scripting: Develop custom scripts to automate platform health checks, reporting, and routine operational tasks using REST APIs and JSON payload processing.

* Security Strategy \& Awareness: Produce security evaluation reports, design security solution scenarios, establish operational procedures, and conduct security awareness workshops.
* Tenable Platform Expertise: Proven experience configuring, managing, and scaling Tenable products (Security Center, Tenable.io, Nessus) in hybrid enterprise environments.
* Technical \& Scripting Skills: Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, JSON processing, and scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or Bash) for operational automation.
* Ecosystem Integration Knowledge: Direct experience connecting vulnerability management tools with IT Service Management (ServiceNow), SIEMs (Splunk, Sentinel), and Directory Services (Active Directory).
* Vulnerability \& Risk Management: Strong understanding of vulnerability scoring (CVSS), threat prioritization, and collaborating across IT/cloud engineering teams to ensure effective remediation.
Security Frameworks \& Communication: Ability to design security policies, draft comprehensive risk reports, evaluate security effectiveness, and lead security awareness initiatives.  
*

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years\+ of Experience
* Tenable Enterprise Mastery: Proven experience designing, deploying, and administering enterprise Tenable solutions (Security Center, Tenable.io / Tenable Vulnerability Management, Nessus Scanners, and Nessus Managers) across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Vulnerability Lifecycle \& Risk Prioritization: Deep understanding of the end\-to\-end vulnerability management lifecycle, including assessment, risk prioritization (CVSS, CIS Benchmarks, CVEs), remediation tracking, and supporting audit and compliance frameworks.
* Automation \& Scripting: Practical proficiency in scripting (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) and working with REST APIs and JSON payload processing to automate platform health checks, scanner deployments, and operational reporting.
* Ecosystem \& Cloud Integrations: Hands\-on experience integrating Tenable with enterprise platforms including ServiceNow, SIEM solutions (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), Active Directory, and major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Cross\-Functional Governance \& Technical Support: Strong technical leadership skills to troubleshoot complex scan failures, define scanning policies, deliver actionable reports/dashboards, and collaborate with cross\-functional IT, security, and infrastructure teams to drive vulnerability closure.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**HR Manager**

**Company:** K.L. Mahajan \& Sons  
**Location:** Meerut  
**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Experience:** 10\+ years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month

**Job Summary**  
K.L. Mahajan \& Sons manufactures boxing equipment, martial arts equipment, fight wear and sportswear. We are hiring an HR Manager to manage all HR operations at our Meerut facility, including recruitment, payroll coordination, training, compliance and employee relations.

**Responsibilities**

*Manpower Planning*

* Prepare job descriptions and job requirements in consultation with HODs
* Identify suitable recruitment sources
* Prepare and update the organization structure on time

*Recruitment and Onboarding*

* Recruit candidates as per department head requirements
* Coordinate walk\-in, campus, personal and telephonic interviews, and obtain HOD approval
* Prepare and issue letters of intent to selected candidates
* Complete joining formalities and collect required documents
* Plan and conduct induction and orientation programs
* Maintain the employee database, records and a position\-wise application data bank
* Prepare job responsibilities for all employees as per SOPs, and review and update SOPs

*Attendance, Payroll and Salary Administration* 

* Maintain attendance in the time management system and generate attendance reports for salary processing
* Coordinate with finance on monthly payroll, including entries for new joiners and unpaid leave

*HR Administration*

* Handle offer release, bank account opening and ID card coordination
* Verify documents and conduct background verification of new joiners
* Resolve employee grievances and queries on leave policy, salary payment and similar matters
* Maintain the notice board with employee recognition and regular updates
* Issue verbal or written warnings for continued absenteeism or leave without prior information

*Exit and Full and Final Settlement*

* Conduct exit interviews for resigned, quit or terminated employees
* Coordinate full and final settlement with finance and circulate relieving notices to departments

*Compliance*

* Support ISO 9001:2015 audits and conduct and close social audits such as SMETA/SEDEX or similar
* Maintain the factory/plant as per compliance requirements

**Requirements**

* Required qualification: MBA
* Required experience: 10\+ years in Human Resources
* Required skills: HR policy execution, recruitment, performance management, training and development, MIS reports, compliance, communication and interpersonal skills, planning and coordination, decision making and problem solving, ability to work under pressure, Microsoft Office
* Preferred skills: Experience with ISO 9001:2015 and SMETA/SEDEX audits, ERP\-based payroll and attendance systems

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: ServiceNow Platform Data Security Engineering- Manager
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


We are seeking a highly skilled ServiceNow Platform Security Engineering Lead to architect and implement secure, scalable, and data\-driven solutions within the ServiceNow ecosystem. This role will focus on platform\-level security, identity and access management, and data engineering, ensuring compliance, governance, performance, and reliability across ServiceNow modules and integrations.**Key Responsibilities**

* **ServiceNow Authorization \& Authentication Engineering**
* Design and implement secure authentication mechanisms using SAML 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, LDAP, and Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA).
* Architect and manage Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) across ServiceNow modules, ensuring least\-privilege access and separation of duties.
* Define and enforce Access Control Lists (ACLs) at the table, field, and record levels to protect sensitive data.
* Implement Scoped Application permissions to isolate functionality and restrict access to specific modules or components.
* Define and own User groups and locations in the platform.
* Develop and maintain user provisioning and de\-provisioning workflows integrated with enterprise IAM systems.
* Monitor and audit login activity, session management, and access violations using native ServiceNow tools
* Collaborate with InfoSec and IAM teams to align ServiceNow access policies with enterprise security standards and compliance frameworks.

* **Security Strategy \& Compliance**
* Define and enforce compliance to security policies, standards, and best practices for the ServiceNow platform in alignment with ServiceNow recommended Platform security shared responsibility model.
* Ensure service now platform is compliant with internal and external infosec requirements and industry best practices
* Establish governance frameworks for secure development, data protection, and risk mitigation.

* **Data Privacy, Security \& Encryption**
* Defining/Implement Service Now data classification, data retention \& data discovery strategy in alignment with Ameriprise data management policies /standards
* Implement data encryption strategy at rest, in transit \& encryption key management
* Determining the data collection, storage, usage, sharing, archiving, and destruction policy of data processed in ServiceNow instances.
* Monitor access patterns and system activity to identify potential security threats.

* **Secure Integrations \& Automation**
* Ensure and mature secure API management for integrations between ServiceNow and third\-party security tools (e.g., Active Directory, CyberArk and Aveksa, Azure AD, RIM, IAM).
* Ensure secure data exchange and prevent unauthorized access to ServiceNow instances.

* **Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Mentor platform engineers and developers on secure coding, identity management, and data handling best practices.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Lead technical design reviews, platform governance, and roadmap planning for platform security aspects

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**


**Technical Expertise:**

* ServiceNow Security: Deep understanding of SecOps, GRC, RBAC, ACLs, and platform security best practices.
* Cybersecurity \& Compliance: Strong knowledge of security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS), regulatory compliance, and risk management.
* Access \& Identity Management: Expertise in SSO, MFA, OAuth, LDAP, and user authentication.
* Integration \& Development: Experience with REST APIs, JavaScript, OAuth, and secure integration practices.
* Cloud Security: Understanding of SaaS security, encryption methods, and cloud\-based security models.

**Certifications**

* ServiceNow Certifications:
* Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* Certified Implementation Specialist – SecOps or GRC


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience securing large\-scale ServiceNow implementations in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government).
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills to interact with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Knowledge of emerging security trends, zero trust architecture, and AI\-driven security solutions.
* Cybersecurity Certifications:
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)


**Experience Required:**

* 15\+ years of IT security experience, with 12\+ years in ServiceNow security architecture, administration, or operations.
* Hands\-on experience in security automation, incident response, and risk management using ServiceNow.
* Prior experience working with cybersecurity, risk management, and IT governance teams.

description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


The Manager, Middleware Services team is responsible for leading the strategy, engineering, operations, automation, security, and modernization of enterprise middleware and container platforms. This role manages a team of engineers responsible for delivering highly available, secure, and scalable platform services that support critical business applications across traditional infrastructure and AWS cloud environments.  

  

The successful candidate will balance people leadership, platform ownership, operational excellence, and technology modernization while partnering with application teams, architecture, infrastructure, security, and cloud engineering organizations. The role is expected to drive adoption of cloud\-native technologies, automation, self\-service capabilities, and engineering best practices that improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Platform Ownership \& Strategy**

* Own the enterprise middleware and container platform portfolio, including web servers, application servers, Kubernetes platforms, container images, and supporting infrastructure.
* Define and execute platform roadmaps aligned to cloud modernization and enterprise technology strategies.
* Ensure platform reliability, resiliency, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Drive technology currency through lifecycle management, patching, upgrades, and decommissioning of legacy technologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience through self\-service capabilities, automation, and platform engineering practices.

### **Cloud \& Platform Engineering**

* Lead engineering and operational support for enterprise Kubernetes and AWS EKS platforms.
* Drive modernization initiatives, including migration of traditional middleware\-hosted applications to cloud\-native platforms.
* Establish standardized deployment patterns, container images, CI/CD pipelines, and operational practices.
* Manage Kubernetes cluster lifecycle activities including upgrades, capacity planning, security remediation, and platform observability.
* Partner with application teams to onboard workloads onto cloud platforms while ensuring operational readiness and supportability.

### **Middleware Services Management**

* Provide leadership for enterprise middleware technologies including: Apache HTTP Server Apache Tomcat Microsoft IIS IBM WebSphere Application Server Red Hat JBoss (preferred)
* Establish standards for platform configuration, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Ensure middleware environments remain secure, stable, and compliant with enterprise standards.

### **DevOps, Automation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Drive automation initiatives using infrastructure and platform engineering tools.
* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support application and platform deployments.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management practices.
* Improve operational efficiency through automation, self\-healing capabilities, and reduction of manual processes.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, customer satisfaction, and cost optimization.

### **Service Reliability \& Operations**

* Ensure operational support for middleware and cloud platforms.
* Accountable for incident, problem, change, and release management processes.
* Lead major incident response, root cause analysis, and implementation of permanent corrective actions.
* Establish service\-level objectives (SLOs), operational metrics, and performance indicators.
* Drive improvements in platform availability, recovery capabilities, and operational maturity.

### **Security, Risk \& Compliance**

* Ensure platforms adhere to enterprise security, risk, and compliance requirements.
* Lead vulnerability remediation and security patching programs.
* Partner with cybersecurity teams to implement security controls and tooling.
* Maintain audit readiness and governance for supported platforms.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.

### **People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing engineering team.
* Drive organizational capability building through training, certification, and career development initiatives.
* Conduct performance management, talent reviews, hiring, succession planning, and employee engagement activities.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

### **Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for middleware and cloud platform services.
* Build strong partnerships with application development, architecture, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams.
* Communicate platform health, risks, modernization initiatives, and strategic priorities to senior leadership.
* Manage vendor relationships and ensure delivery against service commitments and operational expectations.

### **Financial \& Capacity Management**

* Manage platform budgets, software licensing, and infrastructure consumption.
* Drive cloud and infrastructure cost optimization initiatives.
* Forecast platform growth and capacity requirements.
* Ensure efficient utilization of platform and infrastructure resources.

BrainyBuzz Digital is a fast\-growing digital and e\-commerce solutions company building and scaling modern brands through technology, content, and automation. We don’t believe in silos—we believe in ownership. If you enjoy creating, executing, learning fast, and seeing real impact from your work, you’ll fit right in.

This role is not a desk\-only job. You’ll be at the heart of e\-commerce operations, content creation, and on\-ground brand activity.

**The Role**

As an E\-commerce Executive, you’ll manage online store operations while also creating product content, shooting photos/videos, and supporting exhibitions. You’ll work closely with founders, designers, and marketers—learning how real brands are built from scratch and scaled.

If you’re someone who likes startup chaos, creative freedom, and fast growth, this role is for you.

* · Manage daily website operations (products, pricing, banners, collections).
* · Coordinate product uploads, launches, and promotions.
* · Ensure smooth order flow and customer experience.

* · Do basic to intermediate product photography (mobile or camera).
* · Create Instagram reels, short videos, and WhatsApp content.

* · Assist in SEO\-friendly product content and performance tracking.

* · Help with stall setup, product display, and live sales support.
* · Create real\-time photo/video content during events.

**Who Should Apply**

* · You enjoy hands\-on work and learning multiple skills.
* · You’re comfortable with cameras, phones, reels, edits, and quick content creation.
* · You’re okay with work\-from\-office and occasional travel.
* · You want growth, responsibility, and exposure—not just a job title.

**Skills \& Requirements**

* · Graduate in any discipline (skills matter more than degrees).
* · 1–3 years of experience in e\-commerce, digital marketing, or content creation (preferred).
* · Comfortable using e\-commerce platforms and social media tools.
* · Creative mindset with strong execution ability.
* · Strong coordination and communication skills.

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

title: Front Desk Executive
description:
**Job Description – Front Desk Executive**

**Position:** Front Desk Executive  
**Industry:** Real Estate  
**Department:** Administration / Front Desk Executive  
**Location:** Vaishali  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a professional, well\-groomed, and customer\-oriented **Front Desk Executive** with experience in the **Real Estate industry**. The candidate will be responsible for managing the reception area, handling visitors and calls, coordinating with clients, and providing administrative support to ensure smooth day\-to\-day front\-office operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the front desk and reception area professionally.
* Greet and welcome clients, customers, visitors, and business associates.
* Handle incoming and outgoing calls and direct them to the appropriate department.
* Coordinate with the **Sales, CRM, and Project/Site teams** for client requirements and appointments.
* Schedule and manage meetings, appointments, and site visits.
* Maintain visitor records, call logs, and other front\-office registers.
* Handle basic client follow\-ups and coordinate with the concerned sales/CRM executive.
* Maintain records of walk\-in clients and ensure proper lead information is captured.
* Assist the sales team in managing walk\-in customers and initial project inquiries.
* Coordinate refreshments and meeting arrangements for clients and visitors.
* Support administrative activities and other office coordination as required.
* Ensure the reception area is clean, organized, and presentable at all times.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and client information.

**Real Estate\-Specific Responsibilities**

* Handle **walk\-in clients and property/project inquiries**.
* Record and maintain details of prospective customers and leads.
* Coordinate **site visit appointments** with the sales/site team.
* Provide basic information about ongoing projects, locations, amenities, and available services as instructed.
* Coordinate with the CRM/Sales team regarding client visits and follow\-ups.
* Maintain daily records of walk\-ins, calls, inquiries, and site visits.
* Assist in collecting and organizing basic customer documents when required.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good telephone etiquette and customer\-handling skills.
* Professional personality and presentable appearance.
* Basic knowledge of **real estate projects and customer handling**.
* Good coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, and email communication.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Good Hindi and English communication skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

**Qualification**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Prior experience in **Real Estate / Property / Construction / Builder industry** will be preferred.

**Key Performance Areas (KRA)**

* Professional handling of visitors and clients.
* Call and visitor management.
* Walk\-in lead generation and accurate data recording.
* Client communication and follow\-up coordination.

Interested candidates, get in touch with Ms. Nisha at 9311128718 or nishatomar.radon@gmail.com

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
Track Lead \- Process Management, ServiceNow
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Tools \& Automation Engineer plays a crucial role in enhancing operational efficiency through the development and maintenance of automation tools. This position focuses on asset management and ITIL processes, ensuring that all solutions align with organizational standards for quality and cost. The engineer will work collaboratively to deliver high\-quality code and support existing projects while responding to client requests.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Lead Process Management Initiatives By Implementing Itil Best Practices And Optimizing Bmc Remedy And Ca Service Desk Workflows To Enhance Service Delivery And Operational Efficiency.
  

2\. Analyze Client Requirements And Ensure The Support Team Delivers Exceptional Service Aligned With Client Expectations While Identifying Areas For Improvement.
  

3\. Mentor And Guide Project Teams, Fostering Transparent Communication Of Project Goals, Timelines, And Responsibilities To Ensure Accountability And Performance Excellence.
  

4\. Drive Innovation By Proposing New Ideas And Methodologies For Process Development, Leveraging Tools And Automation To Enhance Overall Organizational Progress.
  

5\. Develop And Implement Data\-Driven Solutions Tailored To Customer Needs, Utilizing Servicenow To Streamline Service Requests And Improve Response Times, Ultimately Achieving Positive Business Outcomes.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Strong Understanding Of Itil Framework And Process Management Principles.
  

2\. Proficiency In Servicenow (Snow) Administration And Support.
  

3\. Familiarity With Bmc Remedy, Ca Service Desk, And Avanti For Effective Service Management.
  

4\. Excellent Problem\-Solving And Analytical Skills To Enhance Operational Systems.
  

5\. Strong Leadership Capabilities With A Focus On Team Empowerment And Development.  

  

  

**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Itil Certification (Optional But Valuable)
  

2\. Servicenow Certified System Administrator (Optional But Valuable
